title: Induced EMF magnitude
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be correctly stated as BL√(2gL).

title: Ring acceleration magnitude
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be correctly stated as (B²L²√(2gL))/(3mR).

title: Minimum initial distance
description: Essential: The final answer for part (3) must be correctly stated as L + (mR√(2gL))/(B²L²).

title: Velocity at MP
description: Important: The solution must apply energy conservation to find the rod's speed v₀ = √(2gL) when passing MP.

title: Circuit resistance analysis
description: Important: The solution must correctly calculate the total circuit resistance (3R/2) by analyzing the ring's parallel arc segments.

title: Force balance on ring
description: Important: The solution must apply Newton's second law to the ring, relating the net Ampere force (2B*I*L/2) to its mass and acceleration.

title: Momentum or impulse analysis
description: Important: For part (3), the solution must use conservation of momentum or the impulse theorem to relate the rod's velocity change to the charge/displacement.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Incorrect sign in the Ampere force direction (e.g., on the ring or rod) or in the induced current/Lenz's law.

title: Unit inconsistency
description: Pitfall: Final answers lack correct units or have dimensional inconsistencies in derived expressions.

title: Geometric setup
description: Optional: Explicitly states the geometric condition (rod displacement + ring displacement < initial distance) for the no-contact criterion.
